name: Action-conditional joint economic critic for the frozen Sapling v1 actor
source: Parent raw registry v1_phase_census/latest_games.json as frozen in source_registry.json. Real native responsive pair manifest also bound before fitting. No new original matches for training.
split: All four established physical native intakes #07/#08 maps held; first six #01-06 training. Additional maps assigned by SHA256('joint-rank-v1|' + public terrain hex) modulo 3 (0 held, all else train). Whole physical maps grouped across all auxiliary and terminal records, both seats and duplicates. Exclude the new two pay_policy maps. New here means held from this fit; historical native outcomes already known to project.
aux_sampling: For each original full parent tape sample t=12,28,...,284 and t=298 if present. At each turn retain parent plus up to two alternatives per role, chosen by deterministic SHA order over seed/seat/t and complete joint command. Score same-step transitions with already committed real opponent action. Targets five quantities: our/rival signed bank flow, change in difference of carried goods, live worker and tree counts. One-step branches have no hypothetical terminal result. Exact final turn if terminal simply included in auxiliary.
candidates: Parent joint plus all physically distinct one-unit changes following complete legal actor Prefix, keep teammate physical orders unchanged as an explicit intervention; disallow newly colliding own destinations, new unsupported hire/overspend, or changes to actions missing from public unit IDs. Parent always available. All turns and all three roles, no isolated late tactical trigger. Features include pooled complete action assignments by role, public exposure/attack/defense, cash, terrain and time plus a fixed projection of the genuinely executed Sapling student's own tokens. No original examiner weights, future enemy orders or hidden map as features.
training: Auxiliary Siamese neural scorer, one shared 48-unit tanh layer and 16-unit tanh layer over state and entire joint proposal, compare both predictions by subtraction. Train one seed 70431 for 12 epochs with pairwise MSE on normalized exact same-step economic outcomes, no model selection. Freeze trained hidden layers, fit ridge penalty 60 on training native pair representation differences (plus differences of predicted auxiliaries); separate terminal own and rival official scores. Scale finite numeric inputs with training only. Rank by full two-sided terminal head, correct exact joint equality required.
native_policy: Public proposal menu evaluated against the frozen estimator. Select largest predicted official margin; apply override only if alternative exceeds parent by >=100 official points and every non-parent chosen command is valid at its complete prefix. No model/UI peek to change threshold. Common comparison separates signed two-arm ranking from actual multi-alternative deployed choice (unmatched is unknown).
offline_gate: Before considering new development: held signed >=10 roots and >=2 physical maps; exact offered parent/alternative would choose >=3 different commands across >=2 roles on held signed panel, equal-map official gain over parent positive; actual multi-option deployed decision must coincide with entire signed improved arm on >=2 distinct held maps, across >=2 roles overall, without positive claims on unmatched decisions; an observed accurate full-choice response on one role cannot certify another. Separately check frequency on complete held maps, both seats and time bands. Stop on nonpositive held gains or insufficient action coverage. No formal evaluation from these historic branches.
scope: Existing V1 team uses project PPO it50 and independently trained Sapling. No newly imported partner or examiner parameters. No new original matches unless all frozen gates pass.
